# Offline CPU dependencies

The read-only vendor/ tree supplies NumPy 2.2.6, pandas 2.2.3, Pydantic 2.11.0,
rich 14.2.0 and tqdm 4.67.1 with their pinned transitive dependencies and license
notices. CPython 3.11 on Linux x86-64 is required for the binary modules.
The system-libs subdirectory supplies libz.so.1, loaded by main.py before NumPy.
No installation or download is needed. The NetNomos package has its LICENSE
within submission/. You may edit or replace the submission modules.

The supplied distributions are:

- annotated-types==0.8.0
